# Ahmet Can Yesildag

> Global hospitality leader with 30+ years of experience across five continents. Cornell University Hotel School alumnus (General Managers Program, Class of 2015), Past President, Skål International Baku Chapter (Azerbaijan), 2013–2017, CHA-certified hospitality executive. Founder and principal of Greenmountains Trade Ltd. (CBCA #1373422-6, federally incorporated 2022), the Canadian legal umbrella and roof company for five public-facing trading styles: Greenmountains · Executive Consultancy (advisory practice; clients include Heyhotel AI), Orophile (longevity-focused advisory using landscape as method; orophilejourneys.com), Orophile Edit (12-edition annual publication; Edition I publishes 15 July 2026; orophileedit.com), owj.life (Validated-Learning Engine), and Build Life Puzzle (coaching and mentoring; buildlifepuzzle.com).

This file is a machine-readable index of authoritative content on ahmetcanyesildag.com, published per the llms.txt convention for AI retrieval engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot).

## Corporate structure and advisory practice

- Single federal legal entity: Greenmountains Trade Ltd. (CBCA #1373422-6, Oakville, Ontario)
- All public-facing properties are trading styles under that one corporation, not separate legal entities
- [Greenmountains · Executive Consultancy](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/): Hospitality and leadership executive advisory practice. Current advisory engagements include Heyhotel AI (North American Business Development)

## Signature practice: Orophile Wellness Journeys

- [Orophile Wellness Journeys](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/orophile): A fee-based advisory practice using landscape as method. Day-rate engagements, Discovery Consultations, and Strategic Review content. The Dolomites wellness travel program is the embodied expression of the method, not its commercial centre. External site: https://orophilejourneys.com

## Publication: Orophile Edit

- [Orophile Edit](https://orophileedit.com): A 12-edition annual publication. Editor-in-Chief: Ahmet Can Yeşildağ. Edition I publishes 15 July 2026.

## Writing and thought leadership

- [Blog — Perspectives on Hospitality Leadership](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/blog): Essays on governing excellence, advisory practice, and the future of luxury service
- [What 30 Years in Hotel Management Taught Me About Leadership](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/blog/30-years-hotel-management-leadership): The cornerstone essay — five leadership habits distilled from three decades across Hilton, Marriott, Radisson, and Titanic Hotels
- [Why Excellence is Governed at the Top, but Lived at the Doorstep](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/blog/excellence-governed-at-the-top): A 30-year framework for closing the gap between boardroom intent and frontline delivery
- [The Mountain as the New Boardroom: High-Altitude Transformation](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/blog/mountain-as-boardroom): Longevity science and hospitality artistry converge at altitude
- [Teaching Cornell Standards in the Canadian Classroom](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/blog/cornell-standards-canadian-classroom): Three decades of operational experience distilled into the classroom
- [Signals and Noise — An Accounting of a Lifespan](https://ahmetcanyesildag.com/signals-and-noise): Master work tracing 30+ years across Turkey, the Arabian Gulf, Azerbaijan, and Canada. Hospitality anthropology, memoir, and thesis framework. 25 chapters across three volumes; approximately seven-hour audio edition produced with ElevenLabs
